_comment: Read at request time by app/flags.py. In production this is a flag service
or a table with a five second cache, and the shape is the same: every flag
has a description, a removal date and a rollout, and an unknown flag is off.
The gate fails when a flag is past its expiry, which is the only mechanism
that has ever worked against a codebase with sixty stale flags in it.

payouts_enabled.description: Kill switch on the payout path. Setting rollout to null stops payouts without a deploy and without a restart.

payouts_v2.description: Level 12's saga orchestrator, replacing the naive sequence. One percent, plus the internal test merchant.

vault_tokenisation.description: Level 15's vault in the payment path. Off falls back to the legacy column, which is why it is a kill switch rather than a rollout.

fraud_provider_b.description: Second fraud provider, shadow mode. Off routes every decision to provider A.
